title: if expressions take a block after else
purpose: The expression form of if has no else-if chain.

rejection.justification: grammar if_expr = "if" expr block "else" block; only if_stmt chains else-if. Detection while parsing or analysing is conforming.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: grammar: if_expr requires a block after else; `else if` chains belong to if_stmt only.
